{{Quote|I've always thought Jesi had some voice-over talent|[[Yara Grugara]]|<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay (article)">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20050721ostendalnay|text=Osten Dal'Nay}}</ref>}}
'''Jesi''' was a [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who worked for [[Cularin Central Broadcasting]] part-time during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the CCB recorded an interview of [[Osten Dal'Nay]], Jesi did the voice-over for it.
